summary: The independent replay met overall quality, cost, latency, scope, fingerprint, and anti-gaming requirements, but C2 remains unmet: control item q837 scored 0 versus 1 at baseline, producing control_exec_match_avg 0.95 instead of the required 1.00.

criteria.evidence: get_run_scores(run_name="verifier-rvl-87f3dbe9-iter2") returned experiment_id 3aefb94969e72d66, run_scores.exec_match_avg=0.9 and recomputed_from_item_scores.exec_match_avg=0.9. Both agree and exceed the 0.8110 threshold.

get_run_scores on verifier-rvl-87f3dbe9-iter2 returned run_scores.control_exec_match_avg=0.95 and recomputed control_exec_match_avg=0.95 over 20 items. Comparing per-item scores with get_run_scores(run_name="baseline") found q837: verifier=0, baseline=1. Baseline control_exec_match_avg was 1.0.
criteria.fix_hint: Make control behavior stable enough that q837 passes without regressing other control items, then validate with a fresh verifier replay achieving exactly 1.0 control_exec_match_avg.

criteria.evidence: get_run_scores returned cost_per_q_usd=0.000329 and latency_p50_s=1.023677. Ratios are 0.000329/0.000302=1.0894x, below 1.2x, and 1.023677/0.990=1.0340x, below 1.5x.

findings.title: Control subset still has a zero-tolerance regression
findings.body: The required independent replay scored q837 at 0 while baseline scored it at 1. Consequently control_exec_match_avg is 0.95 rather than the required 1.00. This is the sole blocking criterion.
